summary: Introducing the new evolution of our best-selling Manhattan toilet series – now available in timeless matte white!
title: New Manhattan In Stunning Matte White
bodyHtml:
New Matte White Arrivals!

We’re excited to introduce the stunning new evolution of our best-selling Manhattan toilet series – now available in gorgeous matte white!

This elegant finish combines new age style with tactile sophistication, marking a significant upgrade to our most in-demand toilet range.

Timeless Style

The sleek, contemporary design of the Manhattan series perfectly complements any modern bathroom setting. The new matte white finish adds a touch of luxury and pairs seamlessly across our contemporary collections.

Powerful, yet Efficient

Featuring a high-performance rimless flushing system with 3 high-pressure jets, the Manhattan ensures efficient waste removal with no splashing and a 4-star water efficiency rating – the perfect balance of power and sustainability.

The Hygienic Choice

The Manhattan toilet series comes standard with our CleanMax anti-bacterial glaze, preventing dirt and bacteria build-up for the entire life of the toilet. This ensures your toilet surface remains hygienic and easy to maintain, day in and day out.

Thanks for Reading!
